basic_details.post_name: Senior Engineer, Senior Project Staff and Junior Project Staff / Coordinator

age_limit.details: No age limit is specified for any of the posts.

qualification.details: Senior Engineer (Civil): B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech. in Civil Engineering with minimum 15 years' experience in construction site supervision, Third Party Quality Assurance (TPQA), or related construction projects. Senior Project Staff (Environment, Construction Safety & Health Expert): Any Bachelor's Degree with minimum 2 years' experience in Environment, Construction Safety and Health (ECSH) management for construction projects. Junior Project Staff / Coordinator: B.Tech./B.E. in Civil Engineering with minimum 6 years' relevant experience. Experience acquired as a freelance consultant in relevant construction/TPQA assignments shall also be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Engineer Positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Jammu Engineer Positions is 28th September 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Engineer Positions at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Engineer Positions at IIT Jammu. These include one post each for Senior Engineer (Civil), Senior Project Staff, and Junior Project Staff/Coordinator.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications vary by post. For Senior Engineer, a B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech. in Civil Engineering is required. For Senior Project Staff, any Bachelor's Degree is needed. For Junior Project Staff, a B.Tech./B.E. in Civil Engineering is essential.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: No, there is no age limit mentioned in the official notification for any of the Engineer Positions at IIT Jammu. This makes the opportunity accessible to a wider range of experienced candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Engineer Positions at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration ranges from ₹40,000 to ₹1,00,000 per month. Specifically, Senior Engineer and Senior Project Staff can expect ₹50,000 - ₹1,00,000, while Junior Project Staff will receive ₹40,000 - ₹65,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official IIT Jammu application portal to submit their applications and required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contract positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contract positions at IIT Jammu will primarily involve an interview. This interview can be conducted either online or in physical mode, depending on the institute's arrangements.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Jammu offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification states "No age limit" for all posts, implying that age relaxation rules for reserved categories may not be applicable in the traditional sense. However, it's always best to check the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with freelance consultancy experience apply?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Junior Project Staff / Coordinator position, experience acquired as a freelance consultant in relevant construction/TPQA assignments shall also be considered, provided other eligibility criteria are met.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website for applications is also provided there.
